_meta.notes: Country-scoped curated nodes; link via relationships during ingest.

910.name: Austronesian Settlement of Madagascar
910.label: Event
910.description: Madagascar's unique Austronesian settlement — one of the great maritime migrations, arriving from Borneo across the Indian Ocean; mixed Bantu and Austronesian heritage.

910.name: Austronesian Voyagers from Borneo
910.label: Event
910.description: Outrigger canoe voyages from Southeast Asia (Borneo) across 5,000+ km of Indian Ocean; linguistic and genetic evidence ties Malagasy to Ma'anyan language.

910.name: Bantu and Arab Arrivals
910.label: Event
910.description: Bantu-speaking Africans from East African coast arrive; Arab and Indian traders establish presence; cultural synthesis creates distinct Malagasy identity.

920.name: Early Malagasy Kingdoms and Chiefdoms
920.label: Event
920.description: Rise of regional kingdoms and chiefdoms; Sakalava empire; Antemoro literate class; Indian Ocean trade networks.

920.name: Sakalava Empire
920.label: Event
920.description: Sakalava (Menabe and Boina) establish western Madagascar's largest pre-colonial state; cattle wealth; slave raiding across the Mozambique Channel.

920.name: Antemoro and Sorabe Manuscripts
920.label: Event
920.description: Antemoro (claimed Arab descent) develop Sorabe script — Malagasy written in Arabic characters; unique literary tradition in sub-Saharan Africa.

930.name: Merina Kingdom and Unification
930.label: Event
930.description: Highland Merina kingdom unifies much of Madagascar; Andrianampoinimerina and Radama I; London Missionary Society; Ranavalona I's isolationist reign.

930.name: Andrianampoinimerina's Unification
930.label: Event
930.description: King Andrianampoinimerina unifies the Merina highlands; 'The sea is the limit of my rice paddy'; builds administrative infrastructure.

930.name: Radama I and Modernisation
930.label: Event
930.description: Radama I allies with Britain; abolishes external slave trade; London Missionary Society introduces Christianity and Latin script; modernised army conquers most of Madagascar.

940.name: French Colonial Madagascar
940.label: Event
940.description: French colonial rule under Gallieni; forced labour; 1947 uprising; evolving nationalist movement.

940.name: Gallieni and Colonial Pacification
940.label: Event
940.description: Governor Gallieni's politique des races; abolition of Merina monarchy and aristocratic privileges; construction of colonial infrastructure; forced labour.

940.name: 1947 Malagasy Uprising
940.label: Event
940.description: Major anti-colonial revolt in eastern Madagascar March 1947; brutal French suppression kills estimated 11,000-89,000; MDRM leaders sentenced.

950.name: First Republic and Ratsiraka Socialism
950.label: Event
950.description: Tsiranana's First Republic; 1972 revolution; Didier Ratsiraka's socialist Second Republic; economic decline.

950.name: Tsiranana's First Republic
950.label: Event
950.description: Independence under Philibert Tsiranana; continued French influence; neo-colonial economy; 1971-72 peasant revolts in the south.

950.name: 1972 Revolution and Military Rule
950.label: Event
950.description: Student and worker protests topple Tsiranana; General Ramanantsoa leads transition; instability; Ratsiraka takes power 1975.

960.name: Democratic Madagascar and Political Crises
960.label: Event
960.description: Democratic transition; recurring political crises and unconstitutional changes of government; biodiversity conservation efforts.

960.name: Third Republic and Zafy-Ratsiraka Rivalry
960.label: Event
960.description: Albert Zafy's Third Republic 1993; impeachment 1996; Ratsiraka returns 1997; contested 2001 election sparks crisis.

960.name: Ravalomanana Presidency
960.label: Event
960.description: Marc Ravalomanana consolidates power after 2001-02 crisis; economic growth; Daewoo land deal controversy; overthrown 2009.
